title: I turned scrolling into a football-game control mechanic
author: uxarya
selftext:
\---

Play it here: [https://scrollfc.vercel.app/](https://scrollfc.vercel.app/)

Hey everyone,

I’ve been building **Scroll FC**, a browser-based football game with an unusual control scheme: instead of using the usual movement keys, you **scroll up and down to run forward and backward**.

You use the arrow keys or A/D to move sideways, hover and click to direct passes, and use the keyboard for tackles, lofted passes, shots, and switching defenders. Holding a direction also triggers a sprint, followed by a recovery period.

You can play:

* Against the computer at different difficulty levels
* **1v1 against a friend** using a private match code
* A penalty shootout mode, which I’m still actively working on

It’s still an early version, particularly the penalty shootout gameplay, and I’d really appreciate some initial feedback.

I’m especially curious about:

* Does scrolling feel intuitive after the first few minutes?
* Does controlling and switching players feel understandable?
* Are passing and shooting responsive enough?
* What feels awkward, confusing, or unfinished?
* Does the core idea feel worth developing further?

Play it here: [https://scrollfc.vercel.app/](https://scrollfc.vercel.app/)

Desktop and a mouse or trackpad are recommended. Honest criticism is very welcome.

comments.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
comments.body: Good idea in theory but it will never work right on laptops

replies.author: uxarya
replies.body: I built and tested it on a mac, only played with the trackpad. The gameplay and controls felt fine to me. Btw, I’ve also added controller support. Would love to know how the experience feels for windows users.

replies.author: Embarrassed_Text_347
replies.body: I have a mac laptop and if you scroll a little to far right/left it will move forward/backwards with pages. May not be a big deal usually but if you're in a game or something and you accidentally do that it could be frustrating.

replies.author: uxarya
replies.body: Valid point that’s too irritating. Although, for the gameplay you only use vertical scrolling, lateral movements are controlled by A/D keys.
